cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/stress3.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys, random, time, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from compiler import build_plan, verify_plan, find_cut
seed=int(sys.argv[1]); N=int(sys.argv[2]); mode=sys.argv[3]
random.seed(seed)
bad=noplancut=both=plans=0
t0=time.time(); worst=0; maxrec=0
for it in range(N):
    if mode=='big':
        n = random.randint(8,20); maxl = min(30, n*(n-1)//2)
        caps=[0,1,2,3,4,10,50]
        dmax=6; pmax=8
    elif mode=='huge':
        n = random.randint(4,10); maxl = min(15, n*(n-1)//2)
        caps=[10**11, 10**12, 3, 0]
        dmax=10**12; pmax=5
    else:
        n = random.randint(6,12); maxl=min(18, n*(n-1)//2); caps=[0,1,1,2,2,3]; dmax=3; pmax=6
    nlinks = random.randint(1, maxl)
    pairs = random.sample(list(itertools.combinations(range(n),2)), nlinks)
    links=[(u,v,random.choice(caps)) for (u,v) in pairs]
    k = random.randint(2, min(n,pmax))
    parts = sorted(random.sample(range(n), k))
    demand={v:0 for v in range(n)}; tot=0
    for v in parts:
        if random.random()<0.8:
            demand[v]=random.randint(0,dmax); tot+=demand[v]
    if tot==0: demand[parts[0]]=1
    linkuv=[(u,v) for (u,v,c) in links]; cap=[c for (u,v,c) in links]
    t1=time.time(); plan=build_plan(n,linkuv,cap,parts,demand); dt=time.time()-t1; worst=max(worst,dt)
    cut=find_cut(n,linkuv,cap,parts,demand)
    if plan is not None:
        plans+=1; maxrec=max(maxrec,len(plan['trees']))
        if not verify_plan(plan,n,linkuv,cap,parts,demand):
            print("INVALID",it,links,parts,demand); bad+=1
        if cut is not None: print("BOTH",it); both+=1
    else:
        if cut is None:
            print("NOPLAN-NOCUT",it,n,links,parts,demand); noplancut+=1
print(f"mode={mode} iters={N} plans={plans} bad={bad} both={both} noplancut={noplancut} maxtrees={maxrec} worst={worst:.2f}s total={time.time()-t0:.1f}s")
